# scc_record_review_notification_template_config (Data Source)

Look up an existing RecordReviewNotificationTemplateConfig object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `customized_notification_data_string` (String) Maps to the -CustomizedNotificationDataString parameter.
- `customized_reminder_data_string` (String) Maps to the -CustomizedReminderDataString parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `is_customized_notification_template` (Boolean) Maps to the -IsCustomizedNotificationTemplate parameter.
- `is_customized_reminder_template` (Boolean) Maps to the -IsCustomizedReminderTemplate parameter.
